details.title: Recruit Soldiers From Settlements
details.description: Theodora's main talent revolves around recruiting soldiers from settlements during exploration. Specifically, each settlement has different types of available battalions. After a few turns, you'll recruit one of these battalions at random, and you can assign them to each of your units. Additionally, you can use the available facilities in a settlement, such as the Armory or the Market, as well as talk with townspeople in the settlement.

details.title: Deploy Recruited Soldiers to Search for Items
details.description: Instead of using Theodora to search for items in areas, she can command her recruited soldiers to search areas for her. Deploying soldiers to search takes a few turns to complete. Different types of soldiers also have different Gathering Caps, which determine the maximum amount of items they can gather for you. If you deploy a battalion assigned to a unit, that unit will be unavailable to use in battle until their soldiers return from searching.

details.title: Soldiers Can Also Be Used as Gambits
details.description: Theodora's units can also use Gambits in battle by assigning battalions to each of them. Gambits let your units command their soldiers and attack enemies in their stead. The type of Gambits your units use depend on the weapon type of the soldiers assigned to them, which may affect their effectivity on certain enemies.
